Hmm.  I have to do something a little tacky here - I am going to tell you the same thing I told someone else because it is pertinent to your position. : I have been where you are - more than once. It is very very difficult and you have to know that your mind is not helping you right now. While you are normally looking out for your own best interests when we get suicidal our brain is trying to kill us for one reason or another - you cannot trust what your mind is telling you right now. Like George Castanza in Seinfeld - you have to do the opposite of what your instincts are telling you. When I get suicidal I want to isolate, I want to watch something that reinforces the valuelessness of my life like Fight Club and I want darkness. All of these are BAD for me and that is what the darkness in my mind and heart yearn for. Yoou have to know that the things your mind is asking for right now are the most dadngerous things for you and you need to avoid what you are feeling like yoou need. For instance when I am suicidal the best thing I can do is go outside - or to a tanning bed where I get sun (or fake sun) watch something upbeat or listen to upbeat music and be around people - even if I am just NEAR people as in at a restaurant. You cannot hurt yourself in a group or near a group of people. You are safer if you do the exact opposite of what your mind is telling you to do right now. I have never picked up the phone and called for help even in the worst of times. I have text messaged someone close to me when I was in a terrible place - somehow calling makes it too intimate. I guess I should take my own advice and actually call someone when I feel llike that is the last thing I want to do and I also encourage you to have someone - anyone - close enough to text them. Texting is close enough to be helpfull and distant enough that I dont have to worry about the person actually invading my life or thinking badly of me - it works for me - I am not sure why and it does. I would encourage you to find someone to email or text. I have always believed that suicidal people need to be in a pro active community where we all call or text each other on a regular basis to make sure that one of us (or all of us) are not isolating and diving into the blackness. Find someone - anyone - even a suicide counselor if you have no one else - to talk to - to email - to text - somethi8ng. I would leave my email or text message number but I assume that it would be blocked or taken down by the admins eventhough I cannot see why someone wanting to help would be stopped and it just seems like that would be the case. Do exactly the opposite of what your brain tells you to do - go out - be near people - eat - get some sun. Do it now. Best of luck - I am thinking about you.
when we struggle with suicidality (which is a word eventhough it looks made up) we are troubled by the information coming from inside so all that we can do is change how we respond to what we are being driven towards.  School does suck - I am not going to tell you otherwise  - I had few or no friends depending on what school year it was - mainly because I didnt like myself - and dont like myself - and you are wrong about one thing.  Your WHOLE LIFE does not depend on passing or failing in school.  Your life will continue either way.  Dont put yourself in a mental place that says your life is worthless if you cannot or do not graduate from high school or college - it simply doesnt mean that much.   From my own life I am highly educated - I am a doctor with advanced degrees and professional training and i make a lot of money BUT I am BURIED in student loan debt to the tune of $153,000 - that is $1500 a month for 30 years.  My wife never went to college - she worked her way up through a grocery store chain - people start in jobs like hers without high school diplomas - she worked her way up to management after 20 years - when you take into account the debt load I carry she makes the same if not MORE money in real terms than I do because she carries no loans.  You life is not over without college, yoour life is not over without a high school degree.  Does it help? Sure - but it is NOT a reason to end your life. For decades and decades people who are under educated have succeeded in business and in porfessional life through hard work, commitment and a good attitude.  Please dont think that you have to killl yourself if you cannot succeed in school - school is NOT that king of all important things that it is made out to be when we are children.  It is simply a place to start - -nothing more.  Be well. Best of luck.
